request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: Which harmonised standard (EN number) gives presumption of conformity for vehicle servicing lifts placed on the market from 20 January 2027 under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: {"kind": "unknown", "value": null, "text": "The files do not name a harmonised standard with presumption of conformity for vehicle servicing lifts under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230. Article 20(1) of REG.md (Regulation 2023/1230) only refers generally to harmonised standards whose references are published in the Official Journal. The only EN number tied to a lift in the files is DIN EN 1493, which the MA STAR two-post lift manual says the lift was tested to, and that is not a presumption-of-conformity reference. CORR.md confirms the application date moves to 20 January 2027 (Article 54).", "sources": [{"file": "REG.md", "place": "Art. 20(1)", "quote": "A product within the scope of this Regulation which is in conformity with harmonised standards or parts thereof the references of which have been published in the Official Journal of the European Union shall be presumed to be in conformity with the essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III covered by those standards or parts thereof."}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Annex I, Part A, point 3", "quote": "3. Vehicle servicing lifts."}, {"file": "CORR.md", "place": "Corrigendum, point 10", "quote": "On page 39, Article 54, second paragraph: for: ‘ 14 January 2027 ’, read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’."}, {"file": "mastar-manual.md", "place": "2 Description, 2.1 Service Life", "quote": "The lift has been tested according to DIN EN 1493 and designed for 22,000 lifting cycles under nominal load."}]}
